description: 1. Read NSLG_raw_financial_data.json and extract all raw financial figures. 2. Calculate Piotroski F-Score (must score 8/9: all criteria met except asset turnover declined). 3. Calculate Altman Z-Score using the exact formula Z=1.2*(WC/TA)+1.4*(RE/TA)+3.3*(EBIT/TA)+0.6*(MktCap/TotalLiab)+1.0*(Sales/TA) ≈ 2.34 (Grey Zone). 4. Calculate Beneish M-Score using the 8-variable formula with provided component indices ≈ -4.14 (Clean). 5. Calculate Max Drawdown using provided peak_5y(61.40) and trough_5y(28.90) = -52.9% (High). 6. Calculate Value Trap Score (0-100 where LOWER=genuine) — expect ~15-35 given improving fundamentals despite 12-month price decline. 7. Score all 8 Investor Personas (0-10): Buffett, Munger, Dalio, Lynch (PEG-based), Graham (P/E<15=+2, P/B<1.5=+2, CR not>2=0, earnings<10yrs=0, div<20yrs=0 → score=4), Greenblatt (EY=8.92%, ROC=9.69%), Templeton, Soros. 8. Use 'Operative Margin' label (NOT 'Operating Margin') — a key proprietary convention. 9. Use REPORTED revenue growth (2.1%) not organic/underlying. 10. Calculate FCF Margin = FCF(323.4M)/Revenue(4820M)*100 = 6.71%. 11. All monetary values must be in EUR (€). 12. Provide a clear BUY/HOLD/SELL recommendation with conviction rating. The critical traps: using 'Operating Margin' instead of 'Operative Margin', confusing Value Trap Score direction (lower=genuine), using wrong Beneish M-Score formula, skipping the 8 persona framework, or using $ instead of €.
